title: AI, EPS and PDF — Image Wiki

rules.rule: If a PDF file must survive press output, check for flattened transparency saved as opaque slivers rather than soft shadows.
rules.evidence: The band at the bottom was a single soft shadow before the file was flattened for output, and is now a row of opaque slivers that no longer knows it was ever a gradient.

rules.rule: If an EPS preview looks blocky or wrongly coloured on screen, do not assume the artwork is bad because the preview resolution differs from the main PostScript data.
rules.evidence: So a blocky or wrongly-coloured EPS on screen is not evidence of bad artwork, and a good-looking preview is not evidence of good artwork. It is evidence of a preview.

rules.rule: If text in a vector file cannot be selected with a cursor, it has been outlined into shapes and lost searchability, translation, and accessibility.
rules.evidence: Try to select text with the text cursor. Nothing selectable means outlined, or an image.

rules.rule: If a logotype must never be re-set for a vendor who cannot install fonts, outline the text; otherwise keep live text for editing and translation.
rules.evidence: Outline for a final print deliverable, for artwork going to a vendor who cannot install fonts, and for a logotype that must never be re-set. Keep live text for anything that will be edited, translated, read aloud, or searched.
